cases.title: Scenario matrix row for session close blocking self check-in
preconditions: Testing-plan §3.1 Session open/close coverage block applies (FR-07, FR-08, BR-01, BR-02, AC-01, AC-05).
A class session exists and is transitioned from Scheduled to Open by assigned Lecturer.
Student is actively enrolled in the session class section.
steps: Transition the same session to Closed via POST /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/close or session lifecycle service path.
Submit a student check-in command referencing a valid token previously issued for that session.
Query attendance records and CheckInAttempt rows for the student and session.
cases.expected: The check-in result is rejected with SessionClosed per API §5.1 step 2, a failed CheckInAttempt is persisted with structured outcome and timestamp per AC-18, and no new successful attendance record is created for that student-session pair.

cases.title: Close session transaction persists state and blocks subsequent success writes
preconditions: Real database transaction is enabled for session and attendance modules.
Session is Open with at least one enrolled student without a success check-in yet.
Assigned Lecturer auth context matches the section.
steps: Execute POST /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/close through the application service boundary with Idempotency-Key.
Immediately execute POST /v1/check-ins for the enrolled student against the same session token context.
Read persisted Session, CheckInAttempt, and AttendanceRecord rows for this student and session.
cases.expected: Session state is persisted as Closed with closedAt metadata, failed attempt is recorded with SessionClosed outcome, and no new Present/Late success row is inserted after closure.

cases.title: Illegal check-in after Closed state transition
preconditions: Session currently in Open state and then moved to Closed.
Student actor and enrollment are valid for the class section.
steps: Capture beforeState as Closed after invoking close transition.
Invoke check-in command for the closed session.
Capture afterState and attendance mutation outcome.
cases.expected: beforeState remains Closed and afterState remains Closed with no attendance success mutation; the check-in path returns SessionClosed.

cases.title: HTTP contract for close then student check-in denial
preconditions: Assigned Lecturer and enrolled Student accounts are authenticated.
A Scheduled class session exists for lecturer scope.
Requests include Authorization and Idempotency-Key headers per API design §2.2.
steps: Lecturer calls POST /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/open and receives 200 with data.state Open.
Lecturer calls POST /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/close and receives 200 with data.state Closed, closedAt, and summary counts per API §4.3.
Student calls POST /v1/check-ins with qrToken bound to the same session.
Inspect HTTP status and response envelope fields data/meta/error.
cases.expected: Student request returns HTTP 422 with error.code SessionClosed and Vietnamese message intent in the standard envelope per API §2.3; a failed CheckInAttempt is logged with SessionClosed outcome and no successful attendance outcome is returned.

cases.title: RBAC denial when non-lecturer roles attempt session close
preconditions: One Open session exists in lecturer-owned section.
Student and ITAdmin users are authenticated.
steps: Student calls POST /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/close.
ITAdmin calls POST /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/close.
Lecturer in assigned scope calls the same endpoint as control.
cases.expected: Student and ITAdmin receive authorization denial (HTTP 403 with Forbidden or OutOfScope per API §6.2) while assigned Lecturer succeeds; denied calls do not alter session state.

cases.title: Boundary ordering: duplicate check-in after closure still resolves to SessionClosed
preconditions: Student already has one successful check-in in an Open session.
Session is then closed by assigned Lecturer.
steps: Student re-submits POST /v1/check-ins after session is Closed.
Capture returned error.code and HTTP status.
Verify successful attendance row count for student-session remains one.
cases.expected: API returns HTTP 422 SessionClosed (session-state check at validation step 2 before duplicate rule at step 5 per API §5.1) for post-close attempts and no additional successful attendance record is created.

cases.title: UI journey shows closed-state gating for student check-in
preconditions: Lecturer UI can open and close a session for an assigned section.
Student opens check-in page/session URL in supported mobile browser profile.
steps: Lecturer opens session from session list and confirms Open badge/indicator is visible.
Lecturer closes the same session and verifies session status badge changes to Closed.
Student attempts to submit check-in from check-in form after closure.
Observe UI error message, disabled or blocked submission path, and absence of success confirmation.
cases.expected: Browser flow reflects Closed state and prevents successful student check-in, surfacing SessionClosed-equivalent danger feedback with manual-fallback guidance per FLOW-02 without showing a success state.

cases.title: Closed session renders distinct lecturer and student visual states with SessionClosed outcome
preconditions: Lecturer is logged in on desktop staff shell with an Open session on PG-05.
Student is logged in on mobile student shell at PG-02 check-in route for the same session.
steps: On PG-05, lecturer confirms Close attendance via ConfirmActionModal and observe Closed StatusBadge, hidden QrDisplayPanel, and locked SessionControlBar per ui-states §2.
Student submits check-in after closure and observe CheckInResultScreen outcome state failure-closed.
Verify danger alert variant, Vietnamese copy intent 'Buổi học đã đóng điểm danh' per ui-states §5.1, and no retry CTA per FLOW-02.
Confirm success-present or success-late states are not shown.
cases.expected: Lecturer surface shows Closed domain state (badge, QR hidden, CTAs locked) and student surface shows failure-closed danger alert with SessionClosed messaging — visually distinct from Open and success outcome states.

cases.title: Concurrent close and in-flight check-in resolve against committed session state
preconditions: Open session exists with enrolled student and valid QR token.
Test harness can fire parallel POST /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/close and POST /v1/check-ins.
Assigned Lecturer and Student auth contexts are established.
steps: Submit parallel close command and student check-in request against the same Open session.
Collect HTTP outcomes for both requests.
Query class_sessions table and assert exactly one Closed transition with single closedAt.
Verify check-in attempt outcome is either Success (if evaluated before close commit) or SessionClosed (if evaluated after close commit) with no duplicate success rows.
Assert at most one successful AttendanceRecord per student-session pair.
cases.expected: Close overlaps check-in per testing-plan §7.2: committed session state at validation determines Success or SessionClosed; no duplicate success records or illegal dual transitions.
